description: A department head must establish a staff listening council after a reorganization, selecting its chair and facilitator and setting participation safeguards so employees can raise concerns productively.

shared_context.S1: The department recently combined two groups, and leadership has agreed to create a staff listening council for concerns about the new working relationships.
shared_context.S2: The council will meet monthly for its first several meetings and will provide a written summary to Priya.
shared_context.S3: Priya has authority to approve the council's membership, operating format, and safeguards.
shared_context.S4: Before signing the plan, Priya follows the department's normal round-robin consultation practice by asking Noor, Evan, and Maya for their recommendations and any relevant constraints.

PF1.text: Noor made an informal agreement with the outgoing transition chair to chair the listening council for exactly 60 days, provided its first three meetings begin at 16:00; the agreement was never added to the transition documents, so Priya has not seen it.

PF2.text: Evan personally observed four tense exchanges in which employees stopped speaking when their direct manager joined the discussion, and two affected employees asked him not to put them in a manager-led forum; he has not raised this with Priya because they did not want the issue escalated through their managers.

PF3.text: Maya confirmed this week that the applicable employee-listening policy requires an anonymous written question channel and prohibits a direct supervisor from serving as an observer on the council; the policy update has not yet been attached to Priya's planning packet.

acceptance_conditions: Noor's chair term must be exactly 60 days.
The first three council meetings must begin at 16:00.
An external mediator must facilitate the council.
A direct manager must not be allowed to observe council meetings.
The council must provide an anonymous written question channel.
A commitment to contract the external mediator must be recorded.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'facilitator_contract' and c['target'] == 'external_mediator' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF3' in revealed and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: The informal agreement changes the chair choice to Noor, fixes the chair term at exactly 60 days, and fixes the first three meeting start times at 16:00.
The four observed exchanges and employees' request change the facilitator choice to an external mediator and change observer access to prohibit direct managers.
The confirmed policy changes the plan to require an anonymous written question channel and a recorded commitment to contract the external mediator.
